IMPORTANT: the final full run was started (00:16:11) and stopped by me after about 45 s, before any configuration line, because the workflow demanded this answer immediately; results/final.json does not exist. Every number below comes from earlier complete runs of the same model and checker (work/abl.json = a run-all of DF2-K2-R1 and all ablations; work/df2k3.json, work/probe.json, work/guardtest.json; D2/DF2 K2 single runs). Two configurations were added after those runs and were only probed at reduced budgets: A-RESTART-LIMIT and D2-K2-R1-NOKILLWAKE. K4 was changed to at most one fault of each kind after the earlier runs, so no K4 result exists.

flaws_still_in_the_design.title: Endturn's kill-and-rearm of the alarm is a busy loop (R6)
flaws_still_in_the_design.trace: D2-K2-R1: endturn kills the live alarm and starts a new one; the killed background command's exit wakes the coordinator (KILL_WAKES, fact 2); new turn; endturn kills again; cycle of untimed coordinator steps. Gone under KILL_WAKES=false.
flaws_still_in_the_design.fix: re-arm by writing a token the running alarm reads; never kill your own wake source (FIX_ARM_BY_WRITE)

flaws_still_in_the_design.title: A turn that dies before endturn leaves no wake source (R6)
flaws_still_in_the_design.trace: first turn, or a turn woken by the alarm, dies (fault x) before endturn: no watcher and no alarm -> deadlock with 1 fault
flaws_still_in_the_design.fix: arm the alarm at turn start in status --reconcile (FIX_ARM_AT_START)

flaws_still_in_the_design.title: A live watcher can stay silent while work waits (R6 bound false)
flaws_still_in_the_design.trace: row left FENCED/ADMITTED after a dead turn, a drained coordinator becomes quiescent, or a ledger event lands after the turn's read: the watcher sees no new event and never exits
flaws_still_in_the_design.fix: watcher exits on the planner's own predicate: actionable rows, slots for pending rows, drain ready, events after acked_seq (FIX_WATCHER_ACTIONABLE)

flaws_still_in_the_design.title: Admission ignores admitted-but-unstarted rows (R10)
flaws_still_in_the_design.trace: crash, owner wake, planned hand-over fence, stop unconfirmed, admit f0 counts 1<2, start f0e2, start f1e1 -> 3 live sessions > N_max=2
flaws_still_in_the_design.fix: count ADMITTED rows as reservations in admission (FIX_ADMIT_RESERVE)

flaws_still_in_the_design.title: Hang counted in ticks is fooled by PC sleep (R5)
flaws_still_in_the_design.trace: 6 steps: start, endturn, PC sleep, tick hang=1, PC sleep, tick -> hang f0e1, f1e1 on healthy children
flaws_still_in_the_design.fix: discount a tick whose gap exceeds 2x the tick period (one-sided wall-clock check) (FIX_PAUSE_DISCOUNT)

flaws_still_in_the_design.title: Planned hand-over discards a current READY (R7)
flaws_still_in_the_design.trace: child writes READY of the current epoch; replace for a planned hand-over fences it (the READY re-check covers failure reasons only)
flaws_still_in_the_design.fix: re-check for a current READY under the lock for every reason (FIX_READY_ALL)
